title: Public Statement Approved — Manual Operation Confirmed

fields.headline: Director Approves Public Statement
fields.narration: The Director of Water Operations has approved the revised public statement. The message confirms that the system is now operating under full manual control, with continuous oversight by trained personnel. The public is told that the control system remains isolated due to a confirmed cyber-physical compromise, and that automation will not resume until safety is verified. The statement emphasizes that no decision is being made based on the HMI, and that public health is the top priority. The City will not return to automatic control until two clean sample rounds are confirmed and Ohio EPA concurrence is received.
keyFacts: The revised public statement has been approved by the Director.
The system is operating under full manual control with continuous oversight.
The HMI is not trusted; decisions are based on verified field data and lab results.
The advisory will remain in effect until two clean sample rounds and Ohio EPA concurrence are confirmed.
fields.expectedAction: The PIO releases the approved statement via MillbrookAlert, the city website, social media, and the media contact list. The Control Room confirms that all channels have broadcast the message.
fields.scenarioTitle: pH on the Edge — Caustic Overfeed & Public Health

instructorNote: This inject confirms the public statement has been approved and must be released. The team must now execute the full multi-channel dissemination. Watch for delays in social media or MillbrookAlert deployment.
